instruction: Change my amazon review about the pink t-shirt I ordered last calendar month. Make it 1 star with the title "Stitching Fell Apart in the Washer!".
notes: Single-app task (amazon) plus supervisor. Knowledge chain: show_orders discovers the order placed in the last calendar month (April 2023, current date 2023-05-18), show_order reveals the ordered product, show_product verifies it is the pink t-shirt, show_product_reviews filtered by the supervisor's email yields the review id, and update_product_review sets rating=1 and the new title (text left untouched so only one ProductReview record is updated). Static init facts (order-last-calendar-month, ordered-in, review-of, target-*) describe the entities named by the instruction; no ids or tokens are known initially. supervisor-complete-task carries the review/rating/title as non-API record parameters so its precondition equals the goal conditions; the task asks no question so complete_task is called without an answer.
